people.mina: Mina Harker: a young Englishwoman with dark hair

beats.text: Give the young dark-haired woman Mina's mark: a small dark red mark in the centre of her forehead just above the brows, shaped exactly like the mark in the second reference image: a thin circle with an upright cross inside it whose arms touch the circle, the same size and colour, burned into the skin. Keep her face, hair, clothes, light and the whole background exactly as they are.

Give the young dark-haired woman Mina's mark: a small dark red mark in the centre of her forehead just above the brows, shaped exactly like the mark in the second reference image: a thin circle with an upright cross inside it whose arms touch the circle, the same size and colour, burned into the skin. Remove the column of smoke on the left of the picture entirely and any other mark on her forehead. From the mark, and only from it, a thin wisp of dense white smoke rises straight upward off her forehead and curls away into the sunset sky above her head, as if the mark is lifting away; the mark itself is already fading. No smoke near her mouth. Keep her face, hair, clothes, light and the whole background exactly as they are.
